messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The recent update moved the ‘reserves’ button, causing confusion and requiring the team to be retrained.
  quote: Also, the last update moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.
- problem: Unannounced screen changes cause staff confusion and delays because they have to relearn the interface.
  quote: We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.
- problem: Customers need advance warning and a preview of interface changes before they go live to avoid wasted retraining time.
  quote: we just need a bit of warning and maybe a preview before changes go live, so we don’t waste time retraining.
- problem: Customers cannot preview upcoming interface updates before they are released.
  quote: wanted to check if there’s a way to preview upcoming interface updates before they go live
- problem: Unexpected interface changes force staff retraining and reduce time and accuracy.
  quote: It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.
- problem: Unexpected interface changes move the controls for reserves and payments, causing staff to click the wrong places and make errors.
  quote: Unexpected interface changes keep shifting where we click for reserves or payments — our staff are making errors because the controls aren’t where they were last week.
- problem: Unexpected interface changes force staff retraining mid‑cycle, leading to errors in claims and payments processing.
  quote: The unexpected interface changes have forced us to retrain staff mid-cycle, which is causing errors in our claims and payments processing — we really need advance notice and bundled releases next time.
- problem: Unannounced interface changes force the claims team to undergo repeated, costly retraining.
  quote: It’s about the interface — we’ve had to retrain our claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes. It’s disruptive and costly.
